remarks: Welcome to your own slice of Yorba Linda! This inviting three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath home offers approximately 1,654 square feet of comfortable living space with a welcoming atmosphere and thoughtfully designed layout. The family room features a cozy fireplace, creating the perfect spot to unwind or gather with loved ones. Upgraded bathrooms add a fresh touch, while fresh exterior paint enhances the home’s appeal. A two-car garage provides convenient parking and additional storage. Step outside to your private backyard oasis, where a beautiful pool sets the scene for sunny afternoons and leisurely weekends. Enjoy a refreshing swim, entertain guests, or relax beside the fire pit
